payout_quote: Official Threadless support 'How do Artist Earnings work?': 'Artist Shops — Retail Price - Base Cost = Your Artist Shop Earnings. Each Artist Shop product has a Base Cost, which is equal to the Product Cost plus a 5% processing fee based on your retail price for that product.' And: 'Threadless Marketplace — Purchase Price x 10% = Your Threadless Earnings. Starting February 3, 2025, we're introducing a simplified 10% royalty rate for all sales made from the Threadless Marketplace only.' 'All Artist Earnings are paid through PayPal... typically around the 18th and 20th of each month.'
steps: Create a free Threadless artist account.
Submit designs to the Threadless Marketplace (10% royalty) and/or open a free Artist Shop (set your retail price; keep Retail minus Base Cost).
Customers purchase; Threadless handles production, shipping, and service.
Paid via PayPal around the 18th-20th of each month.
catches: Marketplace pays a flat 10% royalty — you cannot set a higher rate there.
Artist Shops let you set retail prices, but earnings are Retail minus Base Cost (product cost + 5% processing fee).
Promotional pricing can reduce earnings; Threadless guarantees a 10% minimum during managed promotions.
Highly variable; most artists earn little; income depends on designs and traffic.
biggest_catch: The Threadless Marketplace pays only a flat 10% royalty with no way to raise it — and in Artist Shops your profit is whatever remains after product cost plus a 5% processing fee, so earnings per sale are thin and volume-dependent.
eligibility: 18+; original artwork you have rights to.
timing: Paid via PayPal around the 18th-20th monthly.
